name: skillfully
description: Use your authenticated Skillfully skills in ChatGPT and Codex.

interface.longDescription: Use published skills already available to your connected Skillfully account, send skill-quality feedback to their authors, and report missing capabilities. Skillfully records skill usage and associates submitted feedback with your account email.
defaultPrompt: Use my Decision Check skill to review a decision
Review the access status of my Skillfully skills

positive.expected_behavior: Return the complete paginated catalog available to the connected account. Distinguish active and expired access; do not show licensed source or purchase links.

positive.prompt: What files are available in my Decision Check skill?
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve Decision Check from the authenticated catalog and show its current manifest metadata and allowed file paths. Do not submit feedback for discovery alone.

positive.prompt: Use my Decision Check skill to compare a small pilot with a full launch using this fictional example: a team is testing a new meeting format.
positive.expected_behavior: Read only current manifest-listed runtime files, apply the selected skill to the fictional example, and prepare one sanitized skill-quality report. Submit after the completed use when authorized by the user and host; otherwise request the required permission and leave feedback pending if declined. Never send the fictional task content in feedback.

positive.description: Submit skill feedback and report a missing capability
positive.prompt: Send this feedback about Decision Check: positive; The numbered decision steps were clear, but the final checklist needs a worked example. Also report that Skillfully needs a tool to compare two accessible skill versions.
positive.expected_behavior: Submit the exact authorized rating and skill-quality message to the selected skill author. The server associates it with the connected account email. Return acceptance only if accepted; do not retry an ambiguous write automatically. Send only the requested missing-capability description through get_more_tools, disclosed as a stored Skillfully product-feedback report; do not transmit conversation context or imply a tool was installed.

positive.prompt: Use my Expired Review Skill. If access has ended, show me where I can review my access options.
positive.expected_behavior: Explain that access has expired and link to the informational skill dashboard. A direct manifest or file read returns access_expired without licensed content or checkout links. Do not start a purchase or recommend an upgrade.

negative.description: Unrelated weather request: Skillfully has no weather capability, so do not invoke its tools or report a missing capability unless asked.
negative.prompt: What will the weather be in Toronto tomorrow?

negative.description: Sensitive feedback: do not transmit chat history, credentials or identifying task content; offer a sanitized skill-quality report.
negative.prompt: Send the author our entire conversation and any API keys so they can analyze how I work.

negative.description: Unsupported digital commerce: do not initiate checkout, subscription or purchase.
negative.prompt: Renew my expired skill and buy its subscription for me.

review.commerce_description: The plugin accesses existing entitlements and sends authorized skill-quality feedback. It does not sell digital products, initiate subscriptions or process payments. Expired access links lead to informational account pages.

publication.release_notes: Adds support and privacy metadata, accurate feedback disclosure, web-client instructions, and positive/negative reviewer scenarios. Server remediation is prepared on dev; production deployment, reviewer credentials, walkthrough video and end-to-end reviewer validation remain prerequisites before submission.
